mapper.select: select id,message_id,conversation_id,seq,payload from message_outbox where id in ( select id from message_outbox where status = 3 and isnull(locked_at) and next_retry_at <= NOW(3) )

SELECT m.id AS messageId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.seq AS seq, c.conversation_type AS conversationType, m.sender_id AS sendId, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 1 THEN CASE WHEN c.user_low_id = m.sender_id THEN c.user_high_id ELSE c.user_low_id END ELSE NULL END AS toId, c.group_id AS groupId, m.message_type AS messageType, m.text_content AS textContent, m.attachment_id AS attachmentId, m.is_recalled AS isRecalled, m.is_blocked AS isBlocked FROM message m INNER JOIN conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.seq = #{seq} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS messageId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.seq AS seq, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.message_type AS messageType, m.text_content AS textContent, m.attachment_id AS attachmentId, m.is_recalled AS isRecalled, m.is_blocked AS isBlocked, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM message m INNER JOIN user_conversation uc ON uc.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND uc.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY m.seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS messageId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.seq AS seq, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.message_type AS messageType, m.text_content AS textContent, m.attachment_id AS attachmentId, m.is_recalled AS isRecalled, m.is_blocked AS isBlocked, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM message m INNER JOIN user_conversation uc ON uc.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND uc.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.seq >= #{start} AND m.seq <= #{end} ORDER BY m.seq ASC LIMIT #{pageSize}
